# Results walkthrough: index and provenance

*Generated by `eval/figs_results_walkthrough.py` at commit `3264123`. This script only COMPOSES pages: it places existing, cross-checked images (summary charts, the all-flights plots of `eval/figs_walkthrough_flights.py` and the redrawn figures of `eval/figs_walkthrough_extra.py`, whose own checks are in `flights/index_flights.md` and `extra/index_extra.md`); nothing is re-plotted, recomputed or re-run here. All provenance is here; the pages carry none.*

**Second restructure (user request 2026-10-31; decisions D69 onward in `docs/thesis/tier1/decisions_log.md`):** all flights, raw first; every figure self-explanatory (a one-line finding title, the raw / fitted tag and the live / hindsight key on the figure, direct labels, the registered verdicts on the data); captions of at most two sentences (asserted); the Metric / Pass rule / Result of every summary page printed exactly once, verbatim (asserted: 60/60 lines once), in the registered results section, except Experiment 5S, whose page is unchanged. Removed: the Figure 4.2 (a) and (b) pages, the E3 outcome strip plot (now a table), the two intro pages and the appendix E4 change plot. Divider pages: included (drop them with --no-dividers).

**All-flights plots:** 96/96 printed-number checks and 167/167 data-identity checks pass (`docs/thesis/summary/flights/index_flights.md`, sha256 `80c50eeae4f847a4b59080f0b4317939fbc2aa962994846cfceaac358576c0b3`).

**Redrawn and composite figures:** 166/166 checks pass (`docs/thesis/summary/extra/index_extra.md`, sha256 `981ca5f956096838dd094d9b1d0b7cb9ded07c48d9dea6613b8fbec0e8c64f75`).

**Raw / fitted tags:** every figure page carries exactly one tag, drawn in the figure or by the composer (asserted). Tags by page: S1 the drone's true path, nothing fitted; S2 the drone's true path, nothing fitted; 01 raw, nothing fitted (paths); 02 raw, nothing fitted; 03 raw, from the moment the camera stops; no pass rule (descriptive); 04 raw camera heading, nothing fitted; 05 raw, nothing fitted (paths); 07 raw: the drone's true path, nothing fitted; 08 raw heading error, nothing fitted; 09 raw heading error, nothing fitted; 10 raw, against the room's known tag map, nothing fitted; 11 raw, measured from the start tag, nothing fitted; 12 raw, nothing fitted; 13 raw: the drone's real position, nothing fitted; 14 (5S page unchanged: its NOT FITTED label); 15 raw, measured from the start tag, nothing fitted; 16 raw, measured from the start tag, nothing fitted; 16m DESCRIPTIVE, not a registered measure: hindsight track and final map (raw, from the start tag); 17 compute time measured; live error raw, nothing fitted; 18 raw, measured from the start tag, nothing fitted; 20 raw, world frame, nothing fitted; live tracks; 19 FITTED (aligned): the fitted cruise error, the ablation's own metric; A1 pass or fail counts, nothing fitted; A2 DESCRIPTIVE, not a registered measure: hindsight track and final map (raw, from the start tag); A3 additional flights, not part of the pre-registered set.

**Verdict words:** every PASS / NOT MET / FAIL in the composer's titles and captions occurs in the registered Result of its experiment (asserted); the verdict marks drawn in the figures are each equal to the summary page's check row (`sumrow` checks in the two figure indexes). Pages and their verdict words: S1 none (Result of 01); S2 none (Result of 07); 01 NOT MET (Result of 01); 02 none (Result of 01); 03 none (Result of 02); 04 none (Result of 03); 05 none (Result of 04); 07 PASS, NOT MET (Result of 05, 06); 08 none (Result of 05); 09 none (Result of 06); 10 NOT MET (Result of 07); 11 PASS (Result of 08); 12 NOT MET (Result of 09); 13 NOT MET (Result of 10, 11); 15 none (Result of 13); 16 none (Result of 14, 15); 16m none (Result of 14); 17 PASS, FAIL (Result of 16, 17); 18 PASS, PASS (Result of 18); 20 none (Result of 20); 19 PASS, FAIL (Result of 19); A1 FAIL (Result of 15); A2 none (Result of 14); A3 none (Result of 05).

**Checks:** 118/118 reused lines equal their source string exactly; 0 lines MODIFIED; 86 NEW lines (number guard: every number in a NEW or MODIFIED line occurs in the figure's own checked numbers and index or in that page's summary strings: PASS); world check 17/17 trial sets match the worlds pictured on their world page. Failures: none.

**Text source.** Reused lines come from `docs/thesis/summary/index_summary.md`, which `eval/figs_thesis_summary.py` writes from the same strings it draws on the summary pages.

**Layout.** A4 landscape; PNGs at 200 dpi; images embedded unresampled (`interpolation='none'`). The composer's own text is >= 11 pt; text inside a figure is scaled with the figure ('scale'). 'scale' below = displayed width / the image's width at 200 dpi (the summary charts are 150 dpi images and are never enlarged beyond their own size).

**PDF:** `results_walkthrough.pdf` = contents, 'How to read these pages' (NEW, `walkthrough/wt_00b_how_to_read.png`), then 25 figure pages, 7 world pages and 7 registered-results pages in contents order, with the section pages 'Extension experiments (pre-registered)' (the summary's `summary_ext_section.png`, sha256 `603a8763f0fa47004c55a8fd2ef4e3ab58e16b37a4e94b7c2913d3c57b71a2da`, placed unchanged) before page 15, 'Registered results: metric, pass rule and result' (`walkthrough/wt_reg_section.png`) and 'Appendix: further plots' (`walkthrough/wt_app_section.png`) before page A1: 44 PDF pages in all.

**Contents-page note (NEW):** A setup section first shows the corridor and the tag room, and where the drone flew in each. Each experiment then shows all its flights, raw first, with a one-line finding as the title and a short caption; the full metric, pass rule and result of every experiment are printed once, word for word, in the registered results section near the end (Experiment 5S keeps its own page, unchanged).

**Registered-section note (NEW):** The wording of every experiment as registered, printed once, word for word from the reader summary. Where a line points at a part of a summary chart (vertical lines, a grey window, bars, a list on the right, or 'the previous page'), that part is in the reader summary, not in this walkthrough. Experiment 5S keeps its own page.

**Appendix section note (NEW):** Kept for reference, outside the main walkthrough: every registered verdict of extension E3, as a table; two more E3 tag maps; and five additional Experiment 1C flights without the camera heading (additional flights, not part of the pre-registered set).

**How to read (NEW):** Estimators: the same colour and shape everywhere: EKF3 (ArduPilot's standard filter) blue circle, UKF (unscented Kalman filter) green triangle, FGO (factor-graph optimiser) orange square; the true path and every limit are grey. Live or hindsight: filled marks and solid lines are live estimates (made during the flight, fixed-lag); open marks and dashed lines are hindsight (the whole flight re-solved after landing). Figures that use both carry the key in their top-left corner. Raw or fitted: a grey tag in the top-right corner of every figure says whether anything was fitted. Raw means nothing was moved or turned: the error a drone flying on that estimate would face. Fitted (aligned) means the estimate was slid and turned as one rigid piece onto the true path before scoring; the Experiment 1 cruise scores (ATE) are fitted. Titles and marks: each figure's title states its main finding. Registered verdicts are printed on the data, worded as registered (PASS, NOT MET, FAIL); limits are labelled grey lines or bands. Registered wording: the full metric, pass rule and result of every experiment are printed once, word for word, in the registered results section; the captions under the figures are short summaries of them. Units: position errors in metres (m); Experiment 5 hold quantities in millimetres (mm); compute time in milliseconds (ms); times in seconds (s). Every axis is linear.

| Pass rule | VERBATIM | summary page 03, rule | equal | per flight, a heading must be available for at least 70% of the cruise, with a mean error of at most 0.5°, noise of at most 1.0°, and at most 5% of readings more than 3° wrong. |

## Removed or merged in the 2026-10-31 restructure (user request), and why

- **Figure 4.2 (a) page (1A) and Figure 4.2 (b) page (1B):** fitted, one example flight; replaced by the all-flights raw paths with the registered fitted scores in a table (user TASKS 1 and 2). Figure 4.2 itself stays a thesis figure.
- **E3 outcome strip plot:** replaced by the outcome table; the tag maps moved from the appendix into the main E3 section, with a clean reference run added (user TASK 4).
- **Intro pages of Experiment 5 and Extension E4:** their Metric / Pass rule / Result blocks moved to the registered results section.
- **Appendix E4 change-in-live-error plot:** dropped (user TASK 6).
- **'About this plot' and 'This plot shows' lines and the per-page Metric / Pass rule / Result blocks:** replaced by on-figure tags and marks and two-sentence captions; the registered wording is printed once in the registered results section.
